lines.en: label yumidorm35:
I knock on Yumi’s door, fully expecting to be turned away again as we haven’t really had much contact with one another following my decision to mention her mother.
: Thank fucking God!
: Get in here!
Or...I guess I’m going to be hastily invited inside for some reason?
This is new.
: Did I knock on the wrong door? Ami, is that you?
: I’m not your fucking weirdo [niece]!
: I need your fucking help with something. I have no idea what I’m doing right now.
: Okay but, just to be sure, you’re not holding a gun or anything, right?
: This level of excitement only makes sense from you if you’re getting ready to assassinate me.
: I don't have a fucking gun! I’m not that weirdo blonde chick either!
: Are you coming in or do I have to go out there and pull you in by your fucking collar?
scene black
I do my best to stifle the erection forming as a result of Yumi’s sudden switch in personalities and open the door.
scene yumicomp1
Instead of being on her side of the room like she normally is, Yumi sits with her legs crossed underneath the table and nervously prods at some of the keys on Chika’s laptop.
: What the fuck are “sticky keys” and why does this thing keep asking me if I want to turn them on?
: Why would I ever want my keys to be sticky? That sounds gross as fuck.
: Just hit no and it should go away.
: Why are you on Chika’s computer?
scene yumicomp2
: Stupid fucking mall apparently does this thing where you have to apply online to work there, so Chika’s letting me use her thing.
: But I fucking hate computers and I have no idea what I’m doing.
: So...I need your help.
: Does this mean you aren’t mad at me anymore?
: Yeah, sure. Whatever. Helping me with a computer is totally enough to make up for evoking the horrible memories of my absent, junkie mother.
scene yumicomp3
: NO! I DON’T WANT TO TURN FUCKING STICKY KEYS ON! STOP ASKING ME!
: You’re keeping the buttons pressed down for too long. Just tap them and let them go.
scene yumicomp4
: You do it.
: Do what?
: You type for me. This is stupid and is going to take me all fucking night at this rate.
: Sorry, I don’t have Chika’s permission to use her laptop. This is all on you.
scene yumicomp5
: Oh come the fuck on. I really don’t think she’ll care if it’s you.
: If anything, she’ll probably fucking come home and lick her stupid keyboard just knowing you touched it.
: That’s totally not creepy at all.
: Course it’s fucking creepy. You’re both creepy. The fuck does she even see in you?
scene yumicomp6
: Oh! Maybe it’s because you can’t go off and hang out with her mom!
: I’m sure something like that makes a huge difference.
Well...she's definitely still mad.
: I don’t think it does. I’m friends with several of the girls’ moms.
: Of fucking course you are. Real glad to be a part of the club.
: Now, are you going to help me or do I have to bash your fucking brains in with this computer?
: Okay but, fair warning, I’m going to have to sit pretty close to you.
scene yumicomp7
: Whatever. It’s not like your fucking tongue hasn’t been halfway down my esophagus by now.
: There is no way my tongue is that long.
: It’s fine as long as you don’t try to touch me or some shit.
: But, now that I think about it, that’s probably too hard of a task for you.
: Maybe I should just fucking wait for Chika or something.
scene yumicomp8
I sigh to myself and take a seat next to Yumi, realizing that even if she does freak out about our sudden increased proximity to one another, that we’ll be able to move past it.
That’s basically just how things work at this point.
She gets dismissive, I do something shitty, she gets mad, she needs help, I give help, she doesn’t want help anymore, rinse repeat.
: Are you going to type or do I still have to do it?
: You have to do it.
: People who are looking to hire someone your age are probably expecting someone with technical experience.
: Knowing how to use a computer is an incredibly valuable skill.
: Now, click on that bar at the top of the screen.
scene yumicomp9
: This bar up here?
: Okay...now what?
: Type in “Pornhub.com” and see what comes up.
: It’s a surprisingly useful resource for-
scene yumicomp10
: I’m not going to watch fucking porn with my teacher! Help me or get out!
: If you let me finish, you would have found out that Pornhub is a surprisingly welcoming community full of people who can give great advice and-
: Fuck off! No!
: Why do you even remember the name of a porn site anyway?!
: Don’t you just like...type “boobs” into Google or whatever and then just go to town?!
: Actually, don’t answer that! I don’t want to know.
: Right.
: Well, if you’re not going to listen to my first piece of advice, drag your cursor over that little box over there.
scene yumicomp11
: If this is another porn site, I swear to fucking God.
: If the mall’s website lists a porn site in their drop down menu for open applications, I am going to quit being a teacher and go work there instead.
: Kinda hoping it does now. That sounds like a load off my fucking back.
: There. I clicked the thing. Now what do I do?
: Select the store you want to apply to from that list.
: I don’t know what any of these stores even sell.
: What about Chika’s store? They’re listed right there.
: I can’t work at the same place as Chika.
: Does she not want you there or something?
: I think she’d be fine with it. But I’ve seen what they sell and shit and there’s no way I’d be able to...contribute or anything.
: I’d be way out of place.
: None of that shit would even look good on me anyway.
: I don’t think that’s true.
: You definitely pull off your winter look really well and that’s not...low class or anything.
scene yumicomp12
: Are you trying to fucking hit on me right now?
: Not really. Just giving you a compliment.
: I don’t want compliments.
: Too bad.
: You’re really cute whether you want me to say that or not.
scene yumicomp13
: Fuck you.
: So...what do I do now? Just choose a random place and apply there?
: I mean, you’d be fine with most things at this point, right?
: Does it really matter which one you apply to?
: I guess not when you put it that way.
: What about this one? T-Mobile?
: Horrible letter. Pick something else.
: Sprint?
: Why are you only naming cell phone stores?
: I’ve like...been making Chika pay for my phone for a long time now and I feel really bad about it.
: So if I could get like, a free phone plan or a discount or whatever it would probably make things easier on her.
: I hear those places work off commission too and I’ve got like...experience selling stuff and shit.
: I don’t really think it’s necessary to do something like that for Chika.
scene yumicomp14
: Hey, you might not realize this, but everyone else isn’t made of money, dick.
: Chika works her ass off to pay for all three of our phones and groceries. The fuck do you do?
: The first half of what you just said.
: What? The hell does that even mean?
: I pay for all three of your phones.
scene yumicomp15
: What?
: Yeah. So getting a job at a phone store won’t really help out the way you want it to.
: But I guess it would save me some money so...yeah, go ahead and click on the Sprint application.
: Wait wait wait wait wait...
: Are you just screwing with me right now?
: You are, right?
: Why the fuck would you do something like that?
: You’re not making Chika like...do shit in return for it, are you?
: I blame Chinami. Saying no to a cute girl in a dog helmet is apparently not a thing I can do.
: Why include me, though? Why not just pay for those two?
: Don’t ask questions that you’re going to yell at me for answering.
: I won’t fucking yell at you this time. I just don’t get it.
: It’s because I care about you just as much as I care about them.
scene yumicomp16
: Oh bullshit! It’s gotta be something else!
: You can like...probably spy on the pictures I take or something! Can’t you?
Can I?
I’m going to have to look into this.
: See? You’re yelling at me.
: Because I asked you a serious question and you responded with an outright lie!
: Uh-huh. So anyway, click on Sprint.
scene yumicomp17
: R-Right. Sure.
Yumi’s hands begin to shake as she drags her finger across the trackpad and selects the phone store.
Or, I guess it’s possible that they’ve been shaking for some time now.
I admittedly haven’t been watching.
Not because I don’t want to. I mean, she’s adorable in her pajamas.
But because the closer I am to her, the more on-guard she is.
And despite this room being her natural habitat, she’s still the prey right now.
She understands that. And the moment she feels cornered, she’ll attack.
: Okay. Now what do I do?
: Move to the next column and start typing in your info.
: Okay...yeah.
: It will probably take me a little while, so...sorry if you get bored or whatever.
: That’s fine. I have all night.
One by one, Yumi presses down on the keys with her index fingers.
She hasn’t memorized where all of the characters are yet, so she definitely takes some time to make sure she gets everything correct.
I’m a little surprised she’s managed to make it this far into life without ever really using a computer-
But, then again, when you live your entire life just wandering around the streets, picking the locks on pachinko machines and...buying ice cream or something-
You miss out on certain things that other girls don’t have any issues with.
scene yumicomp18
: Uhh...can you look away for a second?
: Why?
: This question here...
: The...sex one.
: Do you...
: Do you think the application is asking you if you’ve had sex before?
scene yumicomp19
: Wha-
: No!
: Obviously not!
: I’m not some kind of idiot!
God I love this side of her.
scene yumicomp20
: I’ll just...
: There.
: Done.
: You selected “male.”
: Well...yeah. I’m not a fucking lesbian, dude.
: Wow. This is one of the greatest moments of my life.
scene yumicomp19
: What did I do wrong this time?!
: Yumi, it’s asking you what sex you are. Not for your experience or who you'd prefer to fuck.
: Are you really that bad at this or are you just trying to get me to fall in love with you?
scene yumicomp21
: I’m that bad, okay?!
: Sorry for being such a fucking moron!
: Don’t worry. I’m sure I sucked the first time I used a computer as well.
I obviously don’t think I was this bad...but I can at least humor her for now.
scene yumicomp22
: Ugh...whatever.
: Can you look away for this part too?
: Your phone number?
: Yeah. I don’t want you sending me fucking...gross pictures at ungodly hours of the day.
: Are...there hours that are okay?
: Fuck no. Never send me anything ever.
: Are you going to look away...or?
: Oh. No. I think I deserve to know your phone number on account of me paying for it and all that.
scene yumicomp23
: Uhh...isn’t that technically blackmail?
: Blackmail? No. Manipulation? Probably.
: I won’t send you any pictures. Don’t worry.
: But if there’s an emergency with Chinami or something, I’d like to be able to let you know.
: Dick move, using the Chinami card against me. That’s not fair.
: Yeah, well, life isn’t fair sometimes. Get used to it.
scene yumicomp24
: Fine...
: But only cause you pay and shit.
: I’m not answering if you just call me to “talk” or whatever.
$ yuminumber = True
Congratulations! You now have Yumi’s phone number!
Yumi finishes typing in her phone number and slowly begins to move through the rest of the application.
She does this for a few more stores with slightly lower standards like fast food places and pet shops before finally deciding to close the laptop and call it a night.
scene black
She gets a text message from Chika shortly after that saying that she’s on her way home and, just as I expected, I was subsequently kicked out of the room.
But at least today’s visit ended on a much more positive note than the one regarding her mother.
Seeing new sides of Yumi is always interesting, especially when they result in the color of her cheeks flushing to the point where they match her pajamas.
I hope to one day see that same level of redness in significantly less wholesome context.
$ yumi_love += 1
$ yumidorm35 = True
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
